items.article: How will changes in income tax bands, USC and credits affect you? T he income tax changes in the budget are set to involve moves in tax bands, credits and the universal social charge (USC) . As such, their impact on individual taxpayers could be very different, depending on how much they earn and other factors. Here is what you need to know. The most significant change for many middle- and higher-income taxpayers will be in this area. The income tax band determines how much of your income you pay at the lower, or standard, 20 per cent income tax rate. The rest of your income is charged at the higher 40 per cent rate. At the moment the top of the standard rate tax band – or the cut-off point as it is also known – is €44,000 for single people, €48,000 for a single parent and €53,000 for a married couple with one earner. items.article: The Lucas Museum of Narrative Art opened in September after more than a decade in development. The venue is not solely a Star Wars museum, but many of its highlights can be found in the cinema exhibit. See more of our coverage in your search results. The greater Los Angeles area boasts more museums than any metropolis in the world — over 800, with 100 in LA proper alone — but none of them offer a $210 R2D2 cookie jar, until now. The Lucas Museum of Narrative Art opened last week, adding a sprawling $1 billion campus to Exposition Park, already home to USC’s famed Coliseum, BMO Stadium, the California Science Center, the Natural History Museum and the California African American Museum. After more than a decade in development — including failed potential sites such as Chicago and San Francisco — the museum finally opened to the public last Tuesday. George Lucas himself and his wife, Melody Hobson, personally welcomed the first 100 guests through the doors.
